title: InviteLinkCreatedData
description: data of invite_link.created (registry 1.6.0, ADR-0046, PE-38). A lead of the team (or an org owner) made a team invite link. tilo-api writes it after the link record was written, never an agent or a model: actor and target are the maker, the world is the maker's Desk world (PE-12), district is null and vis is [] (owner-only, ADR-0009). Ids and the expiry only: never the token, nonce, signature, URL or key. It grants nothing by itself and sends nothing, so it is not a side effect and authz is null.
